تستحرموا (form X)
# تَسْتَحْرِمُوا (tastaḥrimū) /tas.taħ.ri.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# تُسْتَحْرَمُوا (tustaḥramū) /tus.taħ.ra.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
